name: xbert-intercompany-recon
description: Reconcile inter-entity loans, recharges, and trade balances across every group entity in one pass — a unique XBert capability via cross-tenant access.

x-xbert.tagline: Reconcile inter-entity loans, recharges, and trade balances across every group entity in one pass.
prerequisites: XBert account with multi-entity group access
Each group entity connected as a XBert client tenant
Inter-entity loan and recharge accounts identifiable in the chart of accounts
x-xbert.longDescription:
If a client runs a group of entities — operating company, service trust, bucket company, holding company — inter-entity balances always exist. Entity A holds 'Loan to Entity B' on its balance sheet; Entity B should hold an equal-and-opposite 'Loan from Entity A'. Recharges go the same way — management fees, rent, shared expenses. In practice, one side records the transaction and the other side doesn't, or they record it differently, or the GST treatment is inconsistent. Reconciling it means opening every entity's ledger in turn and walking the related-party accounts looking for mismatches. Most tools can't see across tenants so this stays manual.

XBert Intercompany Reconciliation walks every entity in one pass. Because XBert holds the cross-tenant relationships, the plugin can pull each entity's balance sheet, identify the related-party accounts, match the inter-entity balances, flag every mismatch, and produce a per-entity worksheet plus a consolidated reconciliation. This is a unique XBert capability — the cross-tenant relationship data is the unlock. Trade balances between group entities, inter-entity loans, and recharge accounts are all in scope.

useCases.title: Year-end group reconciliation
useCases.description: Before consolidating or producing combined financials, walk every inter-entity balance and surface every mismatch.

useCases.title: Quarterly recharge sweep
useCases.description: Catch the recharge that one entity posted but the other didn't — the most common source of P&L mismatch in shared-services group structures.

useCases.title: Inter-entity loan agreement check
useCases.description: Reconcile every Loan To / Loan From pair across the group and flag any one-sided movement that breaks the equal-and-opposite expectation.

useCases.title: Pre-consolidation working paper
useCases.description: Produce the per-entity worksheet plus consolidated reconciliation the audit / partner needs before group financials are signed.

benefits.title: Cross-tenant by design
benefits.description: XBert holds the group structure. This plugin walks every entity in one pass — no opening each ledger in a separate browser tab.

benefits.title: Equal-and-opposite checks
benefits.description: Every Loan To on one side is matched against a Loan From on the other. Recharges are reconciled both directions. Mismatches are flagged with the missing-side transaction proposed.

benefits.title: Per-entity + consolidated worksheet
benefits.description: Excel workbook with one tab per entity plus a consolidated reconciliation tab — partner-ready and audit-friendly.

workflow: Confirm the group — XBert surfaces the related client tenants automatically
Plugin pulls each entity's BS, TB, related-party contacts, and journal master
Inter-entity balances are matched pairwise; mismatches surfaced with the missing-side entry proposed
Excel workbook with per-entity tabs + consolidated reconciliation drops for review
